name: com.clareohealth/clinical-trials
title: Clareo Health clinical trials
description: Read-only search of public ClinicalTrials.gov trials, with compare, sites and eligibility.

tools.name: search_clinical_trials
tools.description: Search public clinical trials from ClinicalTrials.gov by condition, treatment or sponsor, optionally narrowed by place (city, state, country, or a ZIP code with a radius), status, phase, sex or age. Use this first when a person wants to find trials; use get_clinical_trial when you already have an NCT ID. Each result has public registry fields and a clareohealth.com link. Results are paged: when hasMore is true, call again with page set to nextPage. Send conditions and places only, never a person's name, diagnosis history, medications or other health details. Not medical advice.

query.description: Condition, treatment or sponsor, for example "breast cancer" or "type 1 diabetes". A place in the text ("asthma in Boston") also works; city, state and country are clearer.

recruitingOnly.description: Only trials that are recruiting or enrolling by invitation. Ignored when status is set.

status.description: Registry statuses to keep, for example ["RECRUITING","NOT_YET_RECRUITING"].

sex.description: Keep trials open to this sex. "all" applies no filter.

minAge.description: Whole years. With maxAge, keeps trials whose eligible ages overlap minAge to maxAge. Use the same number for both to match one age.

city.description: City, for example "Boston". Combine with state or country to narrow it.

zip.description: A 5-digit US ZIP code, to find trials with a site within radiusMiles of it. Use it only when the person chooses to give a ZIP for this search. It is turned into coordinates on our server and not stored.

radiusMiles.description: Search radius in miles around zip, or around city with state. Defaults to 50 with a zip. Giving it with city and state searches around that US city instead of matching its name.

sortBy.description: relevance is the registry's order with condition matches first. distance (needs zip, or city with state and radiusMiles) puts the nearest site first among the best 50 matches.

tools.name: get_clinical_trial
tools.description: Read one public clinical trial by its NCT ID (for example NCT01234567): summary, status, phase, eligibility text, every site and links. Use it after search_clinical_trials, or when a person already has an NCT ID. Registry contacts are left out; the trial's page on clareohealth.com carries them. Not medical advice.

tools.name: compare_clinical_trials
tools.description: Read two to five public clinical trials by NCT ID in one call, with the fields that matter side by side: status, phase, conditions, interventions, sponsor, ages, sex, healthy volunteers, enrollment, dates and site count. Use it after search_clinical_trials when a person is choosing between trials. An ID the registry does not know comes back in notFound. Registry contacts are left out. Not medical advice; do not rank trials for a person.

tools.name: get_trial_sites
tools.description: List the sites (facility, city, state, country) where one public clinical trial runs, optionally only those in a city or state. Paged: when hasMore is true, call again with page set to nextPage. Registry contacts are not returned; the trial's page on clareohealth.com links to them. Send an NCT ID and a place only, never personal health details.

state.description: Keep sites in this state or region.

tools.name: get_trial_eligibility
tools.description: Read who can take part in one public clinical trial: the registry's inclusion and exclusion criteria split into lists, plus age limits, sex and whether healthy volunteers are accepted. The wording is the registry's own, unedited and not explained; explain it to the person yourself and do not tell them whether they qualify. If the registry text has no inclusion and exclusion headings, unstructured is true and only criteriaText is filled. Send an NCT ID only. Not medical advice.

tools.name: get_recent_trial_changes
tools.description: Find public clinical trials the registry updated on or after a date, for a condition (query) or to check one trial (nctId). This uses the registry's last-update date only: it tells you a record changed, not what changed, so send a person to the trial page for the details. Give either query or nctId, plus since as YYYY-MM-DD. Paged like search_clinical_trials. Send conditions and places only, never a person's name, diagnosis history, medications or other health details. Not medical advice.

query.description: Condition, treatment or sponsor. Use this or nctId.

nctId.description: One trial to check. Use this or query.

since.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; trials updated on or after it are kept.
